rules.days: Random day durations capped by calendar days per month (1-28)
rules.months: Month-based restrictions can cross months and years
rules.non_applicable: If no matching crop/field/river, event has no effect; never force regeneration
rules.completion: Timed events expire automatically; actionable jobs use Mark as Completed
rules.payment: Payment alternatives are occasional, not mandatory on every event
rules.seasonal: Crop events only in appropriate planting, growing or harvest months; exact official calendar mapping pending verification
rules.balance: Include positive and neutral events, but only when straightforward to carry out in FS25
rules.images: Match title/description to tagged images, fallback to category

events.title: Flooded Field
events.description: Your largest field is flooded. Do not work it for 1–2 months.

events.title: Minor Flooding
events.description: Do not plant on your smallest field for 1 month.

events.title: Waterlogged Field
events.description: Do not use machinery on your largest field for 1–7 days.

events.title: Heavy Rain
events.description: Stop all fieldwork for 1–3 days.

events.title: Persistent Rain
events.description: No harvesting for 1–5 days.

events.title: Flash Flood
events.description: No work on your smallest field for 1–2 months.

events.title: Wet Harvest
events.description: Delay harvesting your largest field for 1–5 days.

events.title: Weather Warning — River Flooding
events.description: Any fields adjacent to rivers are flooded and cannot be worked for 1–7 days. If none apply, the event has no effect.

events.title: Fallen Tree
events.description: Remove one tree yourself or pay £500 to have it removed.

events.title: Storm Damage
events.description: Pay £1,000 for farm repairs.

events.title: Lightning Strike
events.description: Pay £500 for repairs.

events.title: Windstorm
events.description: No spraying for 1–3 days.

events.title: Severe Windstorm
events.description: No spraying or spreading for 1–5 days.

events.title: Gale Warning
events.description: No fieldwork for 1–3 days.

events.title: Dust Storm
events.description: No harvesting for 1–3 days.

events.title: Late Frost
events.description: No planting for 1–5 days.

events.title: Cold Snap
events.description: No planting for 1–7 days.

events.title: Heatwave
events.description: No fieldwork between 12pm and 3pm for 1–7 days.

events.title: Drought
events.description: No fertiliser on your largest field this month.

events.title: Early Frost
events.description: Harvest your smallest ready field within 1–5 days, if you have one.

events.title: Dry Spell
events.description: No grass mowing for 1 month.

events.title: Severe Heat
events.description: Finish all fieldwork by midday for 1–7 days.

events.title: Power Outage
events.description: Pause all production buildings for 1–3 days.

events.title: Storm-Damaged Soil
events.description: Plough your smallest field before planting again.

events.title: Blocked Drainage Ditch
events.description: Remove one tree near your largest field, or wait 1 month. If no suitable tree exists, simply wait.

events.title: Emergency Field Repairs
events.description: Your smallest field is flooded. Wait 1 month or pay £1,000 for emergency drainage to restore access early.

events.title: Flooded Access Track
events.description: Your largest field cannot be accessed for 1–7 days.

events.title: Drainage Contractor
events.description: Your largest field is flooded. Wait 1–2 months or pay £2,000 to restore access immediately.

events.title: Pest Infestation — Largest Field
events.description: Plough an 8m strip around the headland of your largest field.

events.title: Slug Damage
events.description: Cultivate your smallest planted field and re-seed it.

events.title: Bird Damage
events.description: Pay £500 to represent crop losses.

events.title: Wheat Disease
events.description: Cultivate your smallest wheat field and re-seed it, if you grow wheat.

events.title: Barley Pest
events.description: Skip the next fertiliser stage on your largest barley field, if applicable.

events.title: Poor Germination
events.description: Re-seed your smallest newly planted field.

events.title: Compacted Soil
events.description: Subsoil your largest field before planting.

events.title: Drainage Problem
events.description: Leave your smallest field unused for 1–2 months.

events.title: Failed Crop
events.description: Cultivate your smallest growing field and re-seed it.

events.title: Soil Test Failure
events.description: Apply lime to your largest field.

events.title: Poor Field Access
events.description: No machinery enters your largest field for 1–7 days.
